dispositions.cause: the pinned model took the main-agent shortcut in serve mode — 8 chat-turns but the child-session edge never executed; honestly caught by the strengthened delegation verify

observations: Certified battery run 4 (17:23:26.524Z -> 17:26Z): corpus 5/7 resolved (agent-edit-task 11.1s with 5 agent-loop.chat edges; edit-inline 2.7s; apply-fast 2.4s; autocomplete-tab 2.8s; rerank-retrieval 2.6s with scores [1,0,0,0]); 20 edge executions; 34,744 input / 692 output tokens. agent-subagent-delegate FAILed honestly (34.0s, 8 chat edges, child-session never executed — the main-agent shortcut). index-embed BLOCKED at the disclosed supply boundary (/embeddings -> 404; 3 honest FAILED executions, owner Lead).

Replay probe 1/1 durable; failure-path fault-injections validated. Direct same-supply baseline: agent-edit RESOLVED 7.6s (chat-only); subagent 27.9s UNRESOLVED; edit-inline/apply-fast UNRESOLVED direct; surface probes /completions=404 /embeddings=404 /rerank=404; rateLimited=false — the mediation value-add is proven (edit/apply/autocomplete/rerank resolve through Zeck but not direct against the same supply).

Honest reconstruction note: the per-edge Zeck execution ids were recovered from the session narrative (the battery/rail tool outputs preserved in the batch store) and re-pinned by the Lead; all other run numbers are recorded verbatim from the worker's delivered COMPLETION REPORT.

comparison.statement: Agent-edit resolves on both arms (11.1s mediated vs 7.6s direct chat-only); edit-inline, apply-fast, autocomplete and rerank resolve ONLY through Zeck (the direct arm's surface probes return 404 for those surfaces) — the delegated mediation is the value-add, not a pass-through.

limitations.statement: The pinned model declined to delegate through the Subagent tool in serve mode across every certified attempt (run 3's hollow RESOLVED was caught and disqualified; run 4's strengthened verify caught the main-agent shortcut again) — a genuine pinned-model behavioral finding, honestly recorded as not-run with owner Lead.
The sandbox's authorized supply exposes no /embeddings surface (404); the indexing.embed delegation chain ran end-to-end and landed FAILED honestly at that boundary in 3 executions.

The certified run's per-edge Zeck execution ids were recovered from the session narrative (battery/rail tool outputs preserved in the batch store, 28 ids across 6 delegated edges) and re-pinned by the Lead after the 2026-09-30T21:34:30Z worker-pod recycle; the child-session edge honestly carries none (never executed).
